project.name: analyze
project.description: Django loan lending sample app with service, repository and clock abstractions plus HTML templates

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the src package.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the core package.

nodes.name: database.py
nodes.summary: Provides a database connectivity probe that runs SELECT 1 through the Django connection.

nodes.name: database_probe
nodes.summary: Executes SELECT 1 on the default Django connection and returns the result to verify the database is reachable.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the loans Django app.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Defines SystemClock, the production time source returning the local date via Django timezone utilities.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Clock implementation whose today() returns the current local date; satisfies the Clock protocol used by the service layer.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires the Django repository and system clock into a shared LoanApplication instance.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django ModelForm for creating loans, exposing member and isbn fields.

nodes.name: LoanForm
nodes.summary: ModelForm over Loan that validates the member and isbn inputs for lending a book.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model for a Loan, including a computed due date 14 days after lending.

nodes.name: Loan
nodes.summary: Persistent loan record with id, member, isbn, lent_on and optional returned_on, plus a due_on property (lent_on + 14 days).

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed loan repository implementing queries, ID generation, creation and transactional return marking.

nodes.name: DjangoLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Concrete LoanRepository that reads and writes Loan rows; create and mark_returned run in atomic transactions, with row locking on return.

nodes.name: mark_returned
nodes.summary: Locks a loan row, and if it exists and is not yet returned, stamps returned_on; returns the loan and whether it was updated.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Framework-independent application layer: protocols for loan records, clock and repository, the LoanApplication use cases, and CSV-style loan formatting.

nodes.name: LoanApplication
nodes.summary: Use-case facade that lends and returns loans and renders loan text, depending only on injected repository and clock abstractions.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the persistence port required by the application: all, find, next_id, create and mark_returned.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol for a time source exposing today().

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the shape of a loan record the service layer works with.

nodes.name: loan_line
nodes.summary: Serializes a loan to a semicolon-delimited CSV line with dates in ISO format.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing for the plain-text loan API (/loans...) and the HTML UI (/ui/loans/...).

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for the text API and HTMX-aware HTML UI; delegates business logic to the shared LoanApplication.

nodes.name: loan_collection
nodes.summary: GET lists all loans as text; POST delegates to loan_lend.

nodes.name: loan_lend
nodes.summary: Validates the LoanForm, returns 400 with errors or 201 with the created loan line.

nodes.name: loan_detail
nodes.summary: Returns one loan as text or 404 if absent.

nodes.name: loan_return
nodes.summary: POST endpoint that returns a loan, yielding 404 if missing and 409 if already returned.

nodes.name: loan_catalog
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML list of all loans.

nodes.name: loan_catalog_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML detail page for a loan or 404.

nodes.name: loan_lend_page
nodes.summary: Renders the lend form and handles submission, returning an HTMX fragment or redirecting to the loan page.

nodes.name: loan_return_page
nodes.summary: Handles UI return requests, rendering an HTMX status fragment, a 409 detail page, or a redirect.

layers.description: URL routing, views and forms that translate HTTP requests into application calls.

tour.title: Domain Model
tour.description: The Loan model is the heart of the data: who borrowed which ISBN, when, and the computed 14-day due date.

tour.title: Application Service & Ports
tour.description: LoanApplication holds the use cases and depends only on Protocols for repository and clock, keeping it framework-free.

tour.title: Adapters
tour.description: DjangoLoanRepository and SystemClock implement the ports using the ORM and Django timezone.

tour.title: Composition Root
tour.description: composition.py wires concrete adapters into the shared LoanApplication instance.

tour.title: HTTP Layer
tour.description: URLs route to views, which offer a plain-text API and an HTMX-aware UI; LoanForm validates input.

tour.title: Templates
tour.description: HTML templates share base.html; partials are swapped in by HTMX requests.

tour.title: Database Setup
tour.description: The initial migration creates the Loan table and seeds sample data; database_probe checks connectivity.
